_note: SYNTHETIC. SayIntentions documents sayAs as returning 'a confirmation of transmission' with no published shape, so these are the four classes the client must handle, not four observed captures. T-003's inspector records the real one; the classifier in design.md §7.4 is written so an unrecognised-but-2xx body counts as SENT rather than as an error.

success_unrecognised._note: No field the classifier knows, no failure hint → SENT. rawText goes into payload_json.upstream_excerpt so the first real capture is on record.

_body.error: No active flight session found for this API key

no_active_session_via_status._note: 404 and 409 are both read as NO_ACTIVE_SESSION on sayAs (and only on sayAs).

bad_body._note: Not JSON at all → BAD_BODY. An HTML error page from a proxy lands here.
